A1.justification: Both PDFs describe AdaRankGrad and contain readable text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices. Corresponding material can be matched reliably, including the retained proofs and newly added Appendix B.

before.justification: v1 reports original AdaRankGrad results for GLUE fine-tuning, Geneformer cardiomyopathy classification, and LLaMA pretraining on C4.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds a 1B-model C4 comparison and GLUE component ablations.

M1.justification: Algorithm 2 now computes SSRF once at r_max and reuses truncated columns of Q during rank selection; v1 recomputes SSRF for each candidate rank. Algorithm 1 also corrects matrix dimensions. The core optimization and moment-transfer procedure in Algorithm 3 remains unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same eight GLUE tasks, cardiomyopathy classification data, and C4 pretraining task. The added model size and ablations retain this coverage; the Geneformer sample-count revision does not establish a different population or task.

E2.justification: Tables 5–6 introduce constant-update-interval and constant-rank AdaRankGrad variants as controlled comparison methods. Existing external baseline sets remain unchanged, including the methods extended to Table 4's new 1B column.

E3.justification: v2 adds a 1B pretraining configuration with 13.1B tokens and rank/model width 512/2048, plus GLUE controls fixing updates every 200 steps or rank at four. It also revises Geneformer training samples from approximately 187,000 to 93,600 while retaining three epochs and batch size 16. The PDFs do not establish whether that experiment was rerun.

E4.justification: New Appendix B evaluates the two adaptive components through fixed-update-interval and fixed-rank controls across all eight GLUE tasks. These directly examine component contributions beyond v1's retained rank-decay, memory-reduction, and information-threshold sensitivity analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The new tables continue reporting point estimates without uncertainty.

E6.justification: Table 4 adds 1B results: AdaRankGrad reports perplexity 14.71 and memory 3.62G, versus GaLore's 15.64 and 4.38G. Tables 5–6 add component-ablation scores with mixed effects: fixed rank lowers RTE from 81.23 to 80.13 but raises QQP from 90.4 to 91.29. Existing main-table scores are retained.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, theorem and lemma statements, assumptions, and Appendix A derivations are unchanged. Appendix A adds an SGD citation and reflows existing material without revising the proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract and main contribution statements retain the same claims about adaptive low-rank optimization, asymptotic rank-one gradients, convergence, memory savings, and pretraining/fine-tuning performance. Additional experiments do not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Appendix B newly attributes memory savings exclusively to adaptive subspace dimension. Section 5 adds a specific future-evaluation requirement for knowledge editing, including targeted updates and unintended effects. The existing training-time versus memory discussion remains.

D1.justification: v2 documents the new 1B configuration's token budget and rank/model width, and specifies the ablations' 200-step update interval and fixed rank of four. Existing hardware and model-access information is retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds FineGates [SRL24], SGD noise-model work [BWL24], and knowledge-editing work [RBWL24]. It removes the assertion that earlier parameter-tuning methods do not improve inference efficiency. The central positioning against LoRA and GaLore remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Editing is localized: SGD is expanded, the Geneformer subsection becomes a run-in heading, pretraining is renumbered, and brief discussion passages plus Appendix B are added. Most existing prose and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: Table 4 gains a 1B column, and Tables 5–6 are added. Figure 6 is redrawn with epochs 1–3 replacing training-step labels. Figures 1–5 and the general document layout remain substantially unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new component ablations and 1B comparison provide useful empirical checks absent from v1, while corrected matrix dimensions aid implementation. The gain is limited: ablation findings are mixed and lack uncertainty estimates, and the added 1B column is not reconciled with surrounding text and a caption still describing three models up to 350M.
